main_body: multi-story brick campus building with a green roof
top_band: grey roof parapet and green tiled/copper roof deck with vents (rows 1-41)
evidence: Rows 1-41 show the horizontal top roof plane (parapet walls with interior shadow at rows 5-6, green roof deck rows 7-37, front parapet lip at rows 38-41). Below that is a cornice overhang and a three-story brick front facade (rows 42-143) with recessed windows and arched double doors.

style.evidence: While the 3/4 geometry is clear, the brick wall and green roof use a very mechanical, repetitive grid pattern with only 3-4 value steps per material and uniform window stamps, lacking the rich organic per-stone/per-tile shading and 5-6 step specular highlights seen in the Beodeul reference houses.
